file_purpose: Research and evidence profile for the University of Manchester five-year MBChB Medicine A106 course. This file stores the supplied official-source summaries, FOI-derived rules, historical admissions evidence, prediction guidance and known unknowns. It is not the production admissions rules file.

research_scope.evidence_intake_basis: Manchester A106 research-team evidence supplied on 2026-06-30
research_scope.notes: A101 is a separate graduate-entry course. Its historical UCAT figures are retained only as segregated reference evidence and must not enter A106 eligibility, interview or offer logic.

evidence_classification_policy.official: A rule or fact attributed by the supplied research package to a first-party University of Manchester source.
evidence_classification_policy.FOI: A rule attributed by the supplied research package to University of Manchester Freedom of Information disclosures.
evidence_classification_policy.historical_guidance: A past-cycle value that may inform labelled prediction guidance but is not a guaranteed future threshold or current-cycle rule.
evidence_classification_policy.research_derived: A transparent calculation or interpretation made from supplied evidence; it is not a University of Manchester rule.
evidence_classification_policy.unknown: The supplied evidence does not establish the fact safely enough for execution.
evidence_classification_policy.intake_caveat: Source classifications record the provenance asserted in the supplied research package. This intake did not independently browse or re-verify the linked pages.

readiness.production_ready_scope: Candidate for a production audit and implementation of evidenced A106 academic eligibility, contextual rules, UCAT/SJT gates, MMI-only post-interview ranking and labelled Home standard/WP historical interview guidance. Unsupported routes and live thresholds must remain non-executable.
readiness.interview_prediction_ready_scope: Historical guidance bands are supported for Home standard, Home WP/contextual and International applicants from group-separated historical evidence. No historical value is a fixed current-cycle threshold.
route_limited_blockers: No current 2027 guaranteed UCAT cutoff exists in the evidence; historical minimum invited scores may be used only as guidance.
The FOI disclosure identifiers, dates and URLs supporting the tie-break rules were not supplied.
readiness.summary: The supplied evidence supports scoped A106 implementation and clearly labelled historical interview guidance for Home standard, WP/contextual and International cohorts.

transfers_into_course.rule: Transfers into A106 from other medical or dental programmes are not accepted.

repeat_application.rule: An applicant rejected in two consecutive years cannot reapply.

admissions_policy.applicant_group_policy: The policy applies across applicant groups, with separate pathways and thresholds where stated.

applicant_groups.name: Home standard applicants
applicant_groups.definition: UK-domiciled applicants who do not receive the contextual or widening-participation adjustment.

applicant_groups.name: Home contextual or widening-participation applicants
applicant_groups.definition: Applicants verified through UCAS and University data as meeting an eligible contextual or widening-participation criterion.

applicant_groups.name: International applicants
applicant_groups.definition: International applicants ranked in a completely separate cohort and competing only against other International applicants.
applicant_groups.notes: The International threshold is independently determined after UCAT results are available each cycle. Historical values support guidance only and are not a fixed cut-off.

applicant_groups.name: A106 applicants presenting a prior degree
applicant_groups.definition: Applicants holding a previous degree who apply to the five-year A106 course and are assessed through the A106 process with adjusted academic thresholds.
applicant_groups.notes: This qualification route must not be confused with the separate A101 Graduate Entry course.

applicant_groups.name: Graduate Entry Medicine A101
applicant_groups.definition: Applicants to the separate A101 graduate-entry course.

eligibility_sequence: Rank highest cognitive UCAT score first.
If cognitive UCAT scores are equal, prefer SJT Band 1 over Band 2.
Invite until interview capacity is filled.
international_selection_evidence.guidance_disclaimer: This recommendation is based on historical international interview competitiveness rather than a fixed UCAT cut-off.

first_required_science_condition.notes: This is an explicit Biology/Human Biology OR Chemistry condition, not a flat unordered primary-subject list.

scottish.sqa_highers: AAAA by the end of S5, in the same sitting at first attempt
scottish.advanced_highers: AAA, or AA plus one new Higher at A, or AA plus one A2-level subject at A
advanced_higher_subject_guidance: A distinct second science from Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology, Psychology or Physics
One further rigorous academic subject for the AAA Advanced Higher pathway

national_5_minimums.subject: English
national_5_minimums.minimum_grade: B/Standard Grade 2 when not taken at Higher or Advanced Higher

national_5_minimums.subject: Mathematics
national_5_minimums.minimum_grade: B/Standard Grade 2 when not taken at Higher or Advanced Higher

national_5_minimums.subject: Chemistry
national_5_minimums.minimum_grade: B/Standard Grade 2 when not taken at Higher or Advanced Higher

national_5_minimums.subject: Biology
national_5_minimums.minimum_grade: B/Standard Grade 2 when not taken at Higher or Advanced Higher

graduate_applicants_to_a106.degree_subject_scope: relevant life or health science subject
graduate_applicants_to_a106.notes: The supplied evidence does not define the complete list of relevant degree subjects or equivalence decisions; ambiguous degrees require manual review.

contextual_and_widening_participation_ru.verification: Eligibility is confirmed using UCAS and internal University data.

map_guaranteed_interview.condition: The Manchester Access Programme completer meets all minimum criteria.

ucat_and_sjt_rules.score_validity: Scores are valid only for the application cycle in which the test is taken.
ucat_and_sjt_rules.post_interview_exception: UCAT total is used only as the final tie-break after tied MMI totals.
ucat_and_sjt_rules.historical_threshold_policy: Historical minimum invited values may support labelled interview guidance. They are not guaranteed future cutoffs and must not be executed as a fixed 2027 threshold.

historical_ucat_conversion.normalisation: Round to the nearest 5 for derived averages in this file. Minimum-invited equivalents retain the values explicitly supplied by the research team. Exact unrounded results are also stored for traceability.
historical_ucat_conversion.warning: This arithmetic conversion aids presentation across scale changes; it does not establish psychometric equivalence between UCAT cohorts.
historical_ucat_conversion.boundary_warning: The supplied rule permits rounding to the nearest 5 or 10 but does not define a universal tie-rounding convention. Converted figures must not be used as exact executable boundaries.

a101_graduate_entry_reference_only.notes: These A101 values are reference data only. They must not be used for A106 prediction or production logic.

ordered_process: Check that the applicant meets the relevant GCSE, A-level, IB or prior-degree minimum requirements.
Reject SJT Band 3 or 4; only Band 1 or 2 may progress.
Assign the applicant to the Home, Widening Participation, International or Graduate (A101) cohort.
Apply the independently determined cohort-specific UCAT selection boundary.
Rank by highest cognitive UCAT total and then prefer SJT Band 1 over Band 2 when cognitive totals are equal.
Invite until the cohort interview capacity is filled.

personal_statement.use: Checked only for authenticity and motivation.

interview_selection_methodology.map_exception: MAP completers are guaranteed an interview if all minimum criteria are met.

content_areas: motivation for medicine and career awareness
reflection on work experience or volunteering
basic scientific understanding and data interpretation

scoring.aggregation: Station scores are summed to produce a total MMI result.

interview_structure.execution_caveat: The supplied evidence gives ranges rather than a fixed station count and duration for every interview cycle.

offer_selection_methodology.prediction_limitation: An applicant-specific final-offer prediction requires the applicant's MMI total and a cycle-specific offer boundary; neither is available before interview.

historical_admissions_statistics.notes: The supplied evidence provides exact all-applicant annual totals and approximate International competition ranges. It does not establish exact annual International applications, interviews or offers.

historical_prediction_guidance.method: Use group-specific historical minimum invited UCAT values as inputs for later interview guidance bands. Preserve year labels and original scores, show converted /2700 values, and avoid presenting any past value as a guaranteed future cutoff.
prohibited_inputs: historical offer-holder UCAT as a post-interview selection score
limitations: UCAT cohort distributions and interview capacity vary by year.
Arithmetic conversion from /3600 to /2700 is not psychometric equivalence.
MAP completers follow a guaranteed-interview rule when all minimum criteria are met and should not be treated solely through a historical UCAT band.
SJT Bands 3 and 4 remain automatic rejection regardless of a cognitive-score guidance band.
historical_prediction_guidance.disclaimer: This recommendation is based on historical international interview competitiveness rather than a fixed UCAT cut-off.

foi_references.title: University of Manchester FOI disclosures concerning pre- and post-interview tie-break rules
rules_supported: Pre-interview: total UCAT, then SJT Band 1 over Band 2.
Post-interview: total MMI, then total UCAT.
foi_references.notes: The supplied research package identifies FOI disclosures for 2022-2026 but does not include disclosure numbers, dates, files or URLs. These metadata should be added if obtained.

known_unknowns.safe_execution: Apply only evidenced graduate academic eligibility; do not import A101 UCAT thresholds.

known_unknowns.safe_execution: Refer ambiguous graduate degrees for manual review.

known_unknowns.safe_execution: Report offer prediction as partial until an MMI result and appropriate cycle evidence exist.

known_unknowns.safe_execution: Present the supplied 6-8 station and 5-7 minute ranges; do not assert a fixed configuration.

known_unknowns.safe_execution: Retain the FOI classification and flag incomplete provenance during production audit.

do_not_infer: Do not treat a historical minimum invited UCAT value as a guaranteed current or future cutoff.
Do not treat arithmetic /3600 to /2700 conversion as psychometric equivalence.
Do not use A101 graduate-entry evidence in A106 eligibility or prediction logic.
Do not describe UCAT as part of the normal post-interview score; it appears only as the final tie-break after MMI.
Do not treat International historical guidance as a fixed current-cycle threshold.
